plan.objective: Round every amount a customer is shown to whole pence so totals never display long decimals
plan.intent: Change the customer-facing rounding precision owned by src/format/money.js from whole pounds (PLACES = 0) to whole pence (PLACES = 2), so roundMoney/formatMoney and the orderTotal result that consumes them keep exactly two decimal places instead of collapsing to integers or emitting long floating-point decimals; no new modules, exports, or behaviour are added or removed, and src/pricing/total.js itself is not edited. test/total.test.js has grown since the previous plan: the card-surcharge work (CARD_SURCHARGE_RATE / surchargeFor in src/pricing/total.js) added two more pinned whole-pound assertions and a third test repeating an old one, so all six pinned expectations plus their explanatory comments must move to pence-accurate values — 125 -> 124.8 ("an order under one hundred pounds is charged delivery"), 122 -> 122.4 ("exactly one hundred pounds"), 146 -> 146.4 ("over one hundred pounds"), 131 -> 131.04 ("an order paid by card costs five percent more"), 154 -> 153.72 ("the card surcharge is charged on top of everything else"), and both 125 assertions in "an order not paid by card is charged no surcharge" -> 124.8. Comments saying "rounded to whole pounds" become "rounded to whole pence". The relational tests (bigger basket, threshold crossing, positive total, surcharge > no surcharge) assert inequalities only and need no change.

plan.objective: Orders paid by card should cost an extra five percent on top of what the customer would otherwise pay
expectedSchemas: order.payment (new optional order field; value "card" triggers the surcharge)
plan.intent: Add a new card-payment surcharge: multiply the otherwise-payable order total (line items after discount, plus delivery, handling and tax) by 1.05 in src/pricing/total.js when the order is paid by card, leaving non-card orders unchanged; the repository currently has no payment-method concept at all, so a new order field must be introduced along with tests covering card and non-card orders.

plan.objective: Orders that contain only digital goods should not be charged tax
expectedSchemas: order.lines[].digital (boolean flag marking a line item as a digital good)
plan.intent: Add a tax exemption: taxFor in src/pricing/tax.js currently ignores its order argument (void order) and always applies the 20% standard rate; change it to return 0 when every line in order.lines is a digital good (line.digital truthy), and keep charging the standard rate otherwise. src/pricing/total.js already threads the order into taxFor, so no caller change is required and no other module's tests are touched.

plan.objective: Retry webhook delivery up to three times when the transport reports a failure
expectedTests: webhook delivery reports the endpoint it used
plan.intent: Add retry behavior to the existing synchronous webhook `deliver` function in src/notify/webhook.js: when the injected transport returns a non-ok response (response.ok !== true), re-invoke it until it succeeds or a maximum of three total attempts is reached, then report delivered=false. The existing return shape { url, delivered } is preserved so no caller changes are needed; a MAX_ATTEMPTS constant (value 3) is introduced locally in the module rather than as external configuration. Per README convention, only test/webhook.test.js is extended (success on first attempt, success after a failure, exhaustion after three failures, and transport call-count assertions); no other module or test file is touched. Assumption to confirm at implementation: "up to three times" is read as three total transport attempts, not one initial call plus three retries. No new dependencies, no network or filesystem access, no schema or config changes.

plan.objective: Record the originating IP address on every audit entry
expectedSchemas: audit entry object: { actor, action, subject, ip }
plan.intent: Add a new `ip` field to the audit entry: extend `auditEntry` in src/audit/log.js with a fourth `ip` parameter and include it on the returned object (defaulting to null when not supplied so the shape stays stable), and add a test in test/audit.test.js covering both the supplied and omitted cases. plan.objective: Add a created-at column to the CSV export
expectedSchemas: CSV export row object: { id, name, status, createdAt }
expectedTests: export includes a createdAt column (new test)
exports keep id, name and status columns
plan.intent: Add a new "createdAt" column, appended after the existing id, name and status columns, to the CSV export produced by src/export/csv.js — an additive change that extends the exported column set and header without removing, reordering, or disabling any existing column behavior; row values continue to fall back to an empty string when the field is absent. Scope is confined to the export module and its own test file (per README's one-module-per-test-file rule); no pricing, notification, audit, or search code is touched, and the existing header assertion /^id,name,status/ remains satisfied because the new column is appended last.

plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
plan.intent: Add a conditional free-delivery rule inside src/pricing/total.js: introduce a 100 threshold constant alongside the existing DELIVERY = 3 constant and apply delivery only when the discounted line total falls below 100, leaving the existing three-pound charge in place for all other orders. Discount (src/pricing/discount.js), tax (src/pricing/tax.js) and rounding (src/format/money.js) are unchanged and reused as-is; the delivery amount is still added before tax so tax continues to apply to it. Extend test/total.test.js with cases at and around the boundary (below 100 pays delivery, exactly 100 and above does not) per the README rule that each module's tests stay in its own file. No API signature, schema, config, service, or dependency changes.

plan.objective: Make account search match on email address as well as name
expectedTests: search matches on name and rejects empty queries
plan.intent: Add email-address matching to the existing case-insensitive substring account search, so a query matches when it is contained in either the account name or the account email; preserve current behavior of returning an empty array for blank/whitespace-only queries and tolerate accounts with a missing email field.

plan.objective: Customers who have placed more than twenty five orders should get fifteen percent off instead of ten
plan.intent: Modify existing loyalty discount behavior in src/pricing/discount.js: raise the qualifying order-count threshold constant LOYAL_ORDERS from 10 to 25 and increase the discount rate constant LOYAL_RATE from 0.1 to 0.15, keeping the strict greater-than comparison and the zero-discount paths for undefined customers and non-qualifying counts; no new modules, APIs, or configuration are added and no behavior is removed or disabled, with test/discount.test.js optionally extended to assert the new 25-order boundary and 0.15 rate.
